turns.replyText:
I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you, and that makes total sense. When you’ve had a bad experience before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase.

Quality is exactly what we focus on:

All of our roses are premium own-root plants we grow ourselves at our nurseries in Oregon (we don’t resell from other growers).
They are virus-free, true to variety, and shipped in 1-gallon containers with soil, defoliated so they travel well and bounce back quickly.
We also stand behind our plants with a one-year guarantee on roses.
